notes: No precedent in project (first Normann Copenhagen extraction). ACCESS: direct fetch works, no Claude-specific robots.txt block (robots.txt only has User-agent:* Disallow: /downloads/,/system/,/sitecore/,/checkout/,/Json/*,?testlang=). Site is a Sitecore/.NET store where category listing pages render an EMPTY product grid on a bare/first-touch request; the full server-rendered product grid (with a data-totalhits count on the .transientData div) only appears once the client already holds session cookies (ASP.NET_SessionId + website#lang), i.e. visit the homepage once first, then request the category page in the same session. Pagination beyond the first batch is fetched via /CustomSearch/GetResultsAjax?contextId=<page sc.contextId>&q=&f=&groupid=&page=N in the same session. QTY VERIFICATION: for every leaf, data-totalhits was cross-checked against a full-pagination enumeration of unique product detail hrefs to exhaustion (new page requested until no new hrefs appeared) - exact match on every category checked (Lighting-all 183/183, Pendants 77/77, Objects 76/76, Hooks--Shoehorns page 45/45; smaller categories fit entirely on page 0 with data-totalhits matching the visible tile count). EXCLUSIONS (not extracted): Lamp Accessories (39 items - bulbs, fabric cords, canopies, fixing rings, replacement glass = lighting hardware/spares); Organizing (34 items - baskets, toolboxes, laundry baskets, office bins, pocket/nic-nac organizers = storage, not decor); Daily Fiction (34 items - rulers, erasers, pencils, paper clips, stickers, greeting cards = stationery sub-brand, not home decor); Kitchen Utensils, Cleaning, Textiles/Throw-Blankets, all Furniture (chairs/tables/sofas/beds/storage/rugs/poufs/outdoor furniture), News (New Arrivals marketing roll-up of items already counted in their home categories), Designers/Collections/Journal/About (marketing/nav). Furniture>Outdoor checked per Rule 0.1 for hidden outdoor lighting/mirrors - contains only outdoor chairs/tables/benches/stools, nothing decorative. MIXED ROLL-UPS (inspected titles, dropped non-decor items rather than padding): Tableware page shows 23 products; excluded 4 (Normann Teaspoons 6-pack, Normann Spoons 6-pack = cutlery; Craft Pepper Mill = kitchen tool; Bell Opener = bar tool), kept 19 (Cosmic plates, Pipe Pitcher, Mass Dish, Geo Vacuum Jug, Hasle Carafe, Obi Espresso Cups, Geo Sugar Bowl). Hooks--Shoehorns page shows 45 products; excluded 10 Shoehorn / Shoehorn Mounting Fixture items (personal accessory, not decor), kept 35 (Loop Hook, Curve Hook, Curve Mini Hooks, Dropit Hooks, Sticks Hooks, Chip Hook, Hoop Coat Rack) - category relabelled 'Hooks & Racks' in output to match the in-scope content, link still points to the site's hooks--shoehorns page. RULE 0.6 OVERLAP (both counted, not deduplicated): 3 Illu Mirror SKUs (160x55, 80x80, 65x50 cm, EU White) are cross-listed under both 'Wall & Ceiling Lamps' (Lighting type-tree, since they are LED/backlit mirror-lamps) and 'Mirrors' (Accessories) - legitimate per Rule 0.3 (all mirrors incl. LED/backlit are in scope) and Rule 0.1/0.2 (lighting fixtures traversed regardless of overlap). Similarly ~10 'Deko Object' SKUs are cross-listed under both 'Vases' (20 total) and 'Decorative Objects' (76 total) - same product tagged into two genuine site categories, both counted. Children-sum sanity check: Lighting sub-nodes sum to 77+35+25+8+39(excluded hardware)=184 vs the 'All Lighting' landing page's own data-totalhits=183 (off by one, within normal live-catalogue drift tolerance). Site auto-geo-redirected this session to /en/ locale with USD pricing; canonical links kept on the locale-neutral /en/ path per Rule 2, does not affect qty.
